title: The Universal Testimony Of The Cosmos 18th Degree 1st Truth Turning To The Totality Of The Cosmos

questions.question: What does the traveler want to do next to grow stronger in faith?
questions.answer: He wants to look at the whole universe and learn from what it shows.

questions.question: What special tool does the traveler use to look at the cosmos?
questions.answer: He uses a wide, far-seeing way of understanding that he took from the Qur’an.

questions.question: What are two things the cosmos is compared to in the passage?
questions.answer: It is compared to a book and to a palace.

questions.question: Why is the universe described as meaningful and orderly?
questions.answer: Because everything in it fits together with wisdom and purpose.

questions.question: What do the parts of the universe all point to together?
questions.answer: They point to the existence and nearness of one Creator who knows and controls everything.

questions.question: What does it mean that the signs in the universe speak “together” or “in unison”?
questions.answer: It means many different things in creation give the same message.

questions.question: According to the passage, what qualities does the Creator have?
questions.answer: He has complete knowledge, full power, wisdom, and perfect skill.

questions.question: Besides the “book” example, what else in the cosmos gives witness to the Creator?
questions.answer: All species, tiny particles, living beings, and the changes happening in the universe also give witness.

questions.question: How do changes and renewal in the universe help prove its message?
questions.answer: They show that a wise and powerful Maker is constantly managing everything.

questions.question: What main truth about Allah does the whole passage support?
questions.answer: It supports that Allah exists and that He is One.

questions.question: Why does the traveler turn to the whole cosmos after learning from smaller parts of it?
questions.answer: He wants a higher and clearer level of faith.

questions.question: How does looking at the whole universe help the traveler’s earlier lessons?
questions.answer: It makes them more complete and brighter.

questions.question: In the passage, how is the universe like a written work?
questions.answer: Its parts are like sections of a book that all carry meaning.

questions.question: What does the order in the universe show about its Maker?
questions.answer: It shows the Maker is not random but acts with knowledge and care.

questions.question: What idea is taught by saying the Maker sees everything in everything?
questions.answer: It teaches that nothing is hidden from Him and He knows every detail.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the relationships between things?
questions.answer: It says the Creator knows how all things connect with one another.

questions.question: Which small and large things in the cosmos are said to testify?
questions.answer: Both tiny particles and all kinds of creatures testify.

questions.question: What kinds of events inside the universe are mentioned as signs?
questions.answer: Things entering and leaving it, and the changes and renewing happening in it.

questions.question: What can we infer from the phrase about limitless power and endless wisdom?
questions.answer: The Maker can do whatever He wills and does it in the best way.

questions.question: What is the traveler hoping to gain by studying the cosmos?
questions.answer: He is hoping to reach another level of faith.

questions.question: Where did the traveler get the understanding he uses to study the universe?
questions.answer: He got it from the Qur’an.

questions.question: What feeling do the examples of a palace and a city give about the universe?
questions.answer: They show it is arranged, beautiful, and carefully governed.

questions.question: What do the changing parts of the universe still manage to show?
questions.answer: They still show a steady message about one all-knowing and all-powerful Creator.

questions.question: How can things change all the time and still point to one truth?
questions.answer: Their changes happen in a meaningful and wise pattern, not in confusion.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about every level of creation, from large parts to tiny ones?
questions.answer: Every level of creation carries signs of the same Creator.

questions.question: Who is described as the One behind all species and particles?
questions.answer: A unique Maker with unmatched skill and power.

questions.question: What do the words about wisdom and power tell us about creation?
questions.answer: They tell us creation is made on purpose and with perfect ability.

questions.question: What is the strongest main idea of this passage?
questions.answer: The entire universe, in all its parts and changes, points to Allah’s existence and oneness.

questions.question: What does the traveler say before studying the cosmos?
questions.answer: He says they should keep moving forward to gain a deeper level of faith.

questions.question: Why does he want to “listen” to the cosmos?
questions.answer: Because he believes it gives a lesson about truth.

questions.question: What does the passage suggest about the universe when it is called meaningful?
questions.answer: It suggests the universe is full of signs and is not made without purpose.

questions.question: Why is calling the universe an “embodied book” a helpful picture?
questions.answer: It helps us understand that creation can be read like signs that teach us.

questions.question: What do the many parts of this “book” all agree on?
questions.answer: They agree that there is one Creator over everything.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the Creator’s knowledge?
questions.answer: His knowledge covers all things and all their connections.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the Creator’s power?
questions.answer: His power reaches all things without limit.

questions.question: How do the living things and materials in the universe add to the proof?
questions.answer: Their existence, movement, and changes all support the same truth.

questions.question: What is shown by the renewing processes in the universe?
questions.answer: They show that the universe is being managed with wisdom and care.

questions.question: According to the passage, do these signs point to many makers or one Maker? Explain briefly.
questions.answer: They point to one Maker, because all the signs give one united message.

questions.question: What is the next step the traveler takes on his journey of faith?
questions.answer: He studies the whole universe to gain stronger belief.

questions.question: What does using a “telescope” from the Qur’an mean in this passage?
questions.answer: It means he uses Qur’anic guidance to understand the world better.

questions.question: Name one comparison that shows the beauty of the universe.
questions.answer: It is compared to a decorated palace.

questions.question: Name one comparison that shows the order of the universe.
questions.answer: It is compared to a well-run city.

questions.question: What do the lines, pages, and sections of the universe stand for?
questions.answer: They stand for the many parts of creation that all carry signs.

questions.question: What do the changes in creation teach instead of confusion?
questions.answer: They teach that there is wise control behind them.

questions.question: What do all parts of the universe say about the One who made them?
questions.answer: They say He knows everything and has power over everything.

questions.question: What groups in the cosmos are especially named as giving witness?
questions.answer: Species, particles, inhabitants, contents, and things that come and go.

questions.question: Why is the Maker called peerless in the passage?
questions.answer: Because no one is like Him in making, power, and wisdom.

questions.question: What result comes from the witness of the whole cosmos?
questions.answer: It gives a huge and powerful proof of Allah’s existence and unity.

questions.question: What is the traveler trying to improve when he turns to the cosmos?
questions.answer: He is trying to strengthen and brighten his faith.

questions.question: What does the passage teach us about learning from creation?
questions.answer: It teaches that creation can help us understand truth about Allah.

questions.question: Why are book-like examples used for the universe?
questions.answer: Because just as writing has meaning, the universe also carries meaning.

questions.question: Why are palace-like and city-like examples used for the universe?
questions.answer: Because they show beauty, design, order, and rule.

questions.question: What does the passage say the universe clearly points to?
questions.answer: It points to one Creator who is present by His knowledge and power.

questions.question: How do even the smallest things in the universe matter in this proof?
questions.answer: Even the smallest things are part of the signs that support the truth.

questions.question: What is the role of ongoing change in the universe according to the passage?
questions.answer: It is part of the evidence that the universe is being directed wisely.

questions.question: What can we understand from the fact that everything gives the same message?
questions.answer: We can understand that the proof is strong and united.

questions.question: What two main truths are the cosmos said to testify to?
questions.answer: It testifies to Allah’s existence and His oneness.

questions.question: Summarize the passage in one sentence.
questions.answer: The traveler looks at the whole universe through the guidance of the Qur’an and sees that all creation together proves one all-knowing, all-powerful, and wise Creator.
